title: Let lichend failure paths drop secrets and ephemeral state
description: Security/robustness review finding in rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs: main calls process::exit after allocating Zeroizing secrets and EphemeralStateRoot guards. process::exit skips destructors, so failure paths do not wipe secret buffers and leave simulator credential directories behind. Return ExitCode::FAILURE from async main instead, preserving nonzero status while running all drops; add failure-path-friendly structure.
